Lina Park: Welcome Rafi!! :tada: Microgreens are the best. We have a community fridge shelf for food swaps. Label anything per fridge rules.
Ben Rogers: FYI badge lockers row E, combos start with 5. Also the rooftop has a small herb garden if you want to borrow soil tips.
Rafi Hart: Sweet 1 Thanks! Quick poll: rooftop meetup Friday 5:30 for plant swap and drinks? React :herb: for yes or :house: for later.
Lina Park: :herb: Ill bring spare pots.
